content.name: MANUU Connect
content.description: A student-led community at Maulana Azad National Urdu University (MANUU).
purpose: Create a continuous student-to-student knowledge ecosystem
our_story: MANUU Connect is operated by students and alumni.
Current students contribute to the community.
Students gain experience and develop leadership skills.
Graduating students pass the platform to upcoming students.
New students continue and expand the community.
The objective is continuous growth and knowledge transfer between batches.
content.mission: The mission is to create a sustainable student-led ecosystem where knowledge flows from seniors to juniors.

core_values.community_first: Building a supportive network of CS/IT students at MANUU.
core_values.skill_development: Providing hands-on experience through hackathons and real projects.
core_values.innovation_hub: Exploring emerging technologies and creative solutions.
core_values.career_growth: Helping students prepare for careers in technology.
